info.prompt: A cyber-gothic close-up of the banking decision moment—the player's skeletal gold-gloved hand hovering over the Bank button while the unbanked total flickers in electric magenta above a cascading seven-by-seven grid where ice-blocked fives and wild tiles pulse with rainbow hues, the background a void black neural cathedral with alchemical glyphs rotating slowly in the periphery, terminal-style commit logs scrolling upward at a 45-degree angle with timestamps matching the provably fair seed hash.
